patthana19.12:1.1: Naparittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana19.12:3.1: Naparittārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana19.12:5.1: Nahīnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana19.12:7.1: Namicchattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sammattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana19.12:9.1: Namaggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
